art_direction: 深蓝行星只亮起一弯冰青边缘，少量云层与大块暗部形成安静头像。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a nearly dark blue planet seen as a slender icy-cyan crescent. Let the illuminated edge reveal a small amount of cloud texture, while the rest of the sphere remains a readable deep-blue disc against darker space. Position the crescent on the left side and keep the planet slightly above center. Use a sparse field of tiny distant stars with no lens flare. The image should depend on the large arc and dark negative space, avoiding busy galaxies or multiple celestial objects. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
